generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Laying, Testing & Commissioning of 3 Core 185 sq mm cables catering supply to Settling Tank Transformer and Jackwell Pump house Transformer and Miscellaneous works

itemList.description: Disconnection, releasing of 3 core 185 sqmm, 6 core,630Sq mm LT cable and control cables. by excavating approx. 20 meters to release the existing cable. Rerouting/ laying of 3X185 sq mm HT cable, LT cable by providing cable tray of size 450 sqmm width and 15 meters length for new rerouted cables (cable tray is in the scope of contractor)
Shifting and installation of Settling Tank Transformer of capacity 400KVA, 6.6KV/433 volts, ALSTOM make (Lifting machineries if required is in the scope of the Agency)
Supply of end termination kit of six numbers of 1 X 630 sqmm cable at newly shifted place
Supply of end termination kit of one number of 3 X 185 sqmm cable at newly shifted place
Termination of HT, LT and control cables
Testing, Commissioning and Charging of 400KVA, 6.6KV/433 volts, ALSTOM make at newly shifted place
Providing three numbers of pipe earthing at newly shifted place of the Transformer with GI Earth flat of size 50mm*6mm of 30 meters length

Disconnection, Dismantling the existing GOS provided for Jackwell supply and reinstallation, reconnection and commissioning in the new place( within 5 meters area). Providing the earthing in the newly shifted place

Locating fault by patrolling the 3 core 185 sq mm cable, provided for catering to Jack well Pump house. Jointing the cable with 185sq mm Raychem make cable jointing kit, measurement of IR and charging the cable.
Providing two numbers of chain link Fencing for transformer and newly erected GOS of size W*L*H 6*4*5 meter. Providing Danger boards of four numbers each for Transformer and GOS
